schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support scheme for farmers
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 each

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
eligibility_criteria: No pucca house in any part of India
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh for house construction

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.description: Health insurance scheme for poor and vulnerable families
eligibility_criteria: No pucca house or no adult member with education
No adult member with government job
No adult member with motorized vehicle
No adult member with Kisan Credit Card
schemes.benefits: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Micro finance scheme for small businesses
schemes.benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh under three categories: Shishu, Kishor, Tarun

I am a farmer with 2 acres land, am I eligible for any scheme?
